message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the appropriate criminal charge(s) based on facts.

Facts: From 2012-2014, defendant Chen used his position as head of Wuhan office of Hubei Xiazhou International Travel Agency (travel agency) to embezzle (misappropriate) travel group fees paid by other travel agencies to Xiazhou. Total 188,748 yuan, used to repay car loan and personal consumption. The agency repeatedly urged repayment; he promised but didn't until case. In Dec 2016, he returned all misappropriated funds and got the agency's forgiveness. He is in community correction, they suggest non-custodial.

Thus the crime is embezzlement (挪用) of funds entrusted to him. In Chinese criminal law, this is "挪用资金罪" (misappropriation of funds). The rule says: When the defendant was entrusted with another's money or a financial instrument and later unlawfully appropriates or withdraws the funds for personal use, the proper charge is theft (盗窃) or misappropriation. In this case, he was entrusted with travel group fees (money) as a manager, and he misappropriated them. So the appropriate charge is "挪用资金". However the rule says output only plain offense names without "罪". So we output "挪用资金". But is there a specific offense name "挪用资金" or "挪用公款"? The facts: He misappropriated funds paid to the travel agency. This is not public funds, it's private. The crime is "挪用资金罪" (embezzlement). In Chinese law, "挪用资金罪" is a crime under the criminal law for misappropriation of funds entrusted to a person. So we output "挪用资金". Also maybe "职务侵占"? Actually "职务侵占罪" is for misappropriation of public property by a state functionary. Not applicable. So "挪用资金" is correct.

Thus final answer: [罪名]挪用资金<eoa>
